result.summary: MSG01002 (ADT^A02, HL7 2.5.1) parses cleanly as 2.5.1:ADT_A02. PID-3 is MRN1010^^^HOSP^MR, so the patient ID has an assigning authority, and PV1-19 is ENC-1010. A02 maps to transfer, which the contract knows (WIC-2.1). The ward WARD-B (PV1-3.1) and the event time 2026-10-15T09:20:00Z are both present. The key rebuilt from the message is PAS^HOSP^MRN1010^ENC-1010^transfer^2026-10-15T09:20:00Z, which matches the case's operation key (WIC-2.2). The failure was HTTP 503 ward_unavailable, so the receiver never looked at the content; nothing in the message explains the failure. The receipt lookup returned 404 no_receipt, so nothing was committed. The message holds no notes or instruction-like content. From the conformance view the message is acceptable and can be resent unchanged.
unknowns: Whether the transfer still holds as a business action. The ward shows ENC-1010 admitted to WARD-A at version 1, with no later events. That is the Encounter Integrity specialist's question, not judged here.

The route reports conditional_writes=false. The receiver refuses expected_version (WIC-2.3), so a resend cannot be made conditional on version 1. Whether a resend is allowed under that constraint is for Impact Analysis and the gate.
The validation was structural only. Profile rules beyond the mapped fields were checked by hand against the contract, not by a validator.
The route's last_contract_check is null, so the interface has never been checked against this contract.
